messages:
nina: Big thanks to @omar — intercepted the rogue bagel box and saved breakfast for the hiring panel this morning. Youre a lifesaver! :bagel::sparkles:
omar: Haha it was a valiant effort. Someone mislabeled 'team breakfast' as 'mystery snacks'. I rounded them up and dropped a note on the fridge.
keisha: OMAR THE BAGEL BAILOUT HERO. My mouth is still thanking you. Nominate for the weekly shoutouts?
lucas: +1 from interviews — they loved the spread. Also extra points for keeping the everything bagels intact. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: FYI: Kitchen inventory updated. Removed 1 x "unscheduled bagel box" from floor stock. Suggested action: add a small "Label & Date" sticker pack to pantry supplies. Order template: PANTRY-STACK-11.
maya: I added a little sticky with "If you brought it, please label it" and an emoji key. Also proposing a tiny "breakfast budget" (<= $30/month) so folks can bring shared morning treats without ambiguity. Thoughts?
keisha: Love that. Less scavenger-hunt mornings please. :laughing:
nina: If we set a recurring 'Team Breakfast' pickup on Fridays we can keep it organized. @omar you are officially on the bagel rotation this week — we will supply the thank-you sticker. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
omar: I accept, but only if someone else handles cream cheese procurement. Trades?
lucas: I can do cream cheese once a month. Also adding an emoji poll: :bagel: for "weekly rotation" or :calendar: for "monthly pop-up". React to vote.
maya: :bagel:
keisha: :calendar:
nina: :bagel: (team morale wins)
ops-bot: Note: Suggest adding "Label & Date" stickers to next office run. Vendors: https://vendors.internal/pantry.
omar: Thanks everyone  happy the interviewers saw us as organized humans instead of snack hoarders. 
keisha: Tiny acts = big vibes. Sending virtual confetti to Omar. :confetti_ball:
